{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The initial defense of Kachiro ''[sic]'' was entrusted to a small battle group led by Commander Faie&mdash;a battalion of swamp scouts from the 501st Legion, a troop of Republic Commandos, and airborne light cavalry from the 7th Aleena Reconnaissance Regiment, backed up by the local Wookiee militia.|Commander [[Gett]]|<ref name="TEGTWAC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>}}
The '''7th Aleena Reconnaissance Regiment''' was a military unit that served by the side of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Under a small battle group led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]], the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] fought alongside the local [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] militia at the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] during the initial [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|defense]] there in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], providing airborne light cavalry for the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Swamp trooper/Legends|swamp trooper]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] amidst a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] assault.<ref name="TEGTWAC" />
